notes: Full-stack Bill of Materials (BOM) standard organization and OWASP flagship project, standardized by Ecma International Technical Committee 54 (TC54) as ECMA-424. Publishes specifications and schemas for Software (SBOM), AI/ML (ML-BOM), Cryptography (CBOM), Hardware (HBOM), SaaS (SaaSBOM), Operations (OBOM), Manufacturing (MBOM), and Vulnerability Exploitability (VDR/VEX). For the CycloneDX BOM specification, JSON/XML/Protobuf schemas, and ML-BOM element definitions, see secid:reference/cyclonedx.org/cyclonedx.

data.description: Full-stack BOM standard (ECMA-424) covering SBOM, ML-BOM (modelCard + componentData), CBOM, HBOM, SaaSBOM, and VEX. Addressable schema definitions and ML-BOM subpaths are indexed under secid:reference/cyclonedx.org/cyclonedx.
